commit.subject: LU-18687 build: rework Lustre headers for upstreaming
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: rework Lustre headers for upstreaming

We have many ifdef HAVE_HEADER which makes upstreaming
more difficult. Create compat headers to clean up the
ifdefs. Also include headers we need to build against
the Linux kernel

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: James Simmons <jsimmons@infradead.org>
Change-Id: I2e32960dc2203f03f348821ffa33f5a169add42a
